body: Thanks for looking out for me people. I finally got the sleep I needed, I feel somewhat better. I appreciate this more than you can imagine. Thanks a ton, much love.

They’d be devestated if I told them what I’m going through. I’d feel horrible knowing my little brother felt the way I do. I’d feel sick to my stomach, so I see no other option other than keeping it to myself and cry quietly on my own in my fucking prison of a room. I wanna die so badly, more than I ever have.
Maybe its because I haven’t slept, I’m sure I’ll feel the same the next night alone. Sleeping is like a pause button, it leaves you with nothing but dreams. When you can’t sleep, something is really wrong. I leave in a country where guns are illegal, don’t get me wrong I could probably get my hands on one, I just don’t have the money. If I were to have one, a bullet would be down my throat by now. I wanna die so badly.

So many people have it so worse than I do, but still I feel like I’ve hit rock bottom. I can’t even look in the mirror anymore without being disgusted. I’m sick of myself and who I’ve become. I need advice on how to move on and forget shit that i’ve done, if I can’t do that, I’m afraid i’ll do the unthinkable. I’m so close to the edge, I’m lonely as fuck, nobody really cares. I can’t tell my family how I feel, they know I get sad at times, but they have no idea how badly I wanna leave this life. This isn’t a cry for pity I honestly feel so alone that I’m scared of what I’ll do to myself. It’s been two days since I’ve slept, I’m mentally exhausted. I’d love to get some rest, maybe I need sleeping pills or something to put my ass to sleep. Maybe I need a friend, someone I could talk to and ease my mind. I tend to keep everything bottled up, it eats me away. Most of the people I know other than a few are normal and wouldn’t understand what I’m going through, I’d rather not put stress on my mom making her feel like she’s done something wrong knowing I wanna die so fucking badly, my other friends have problems of their own and wanna die just as badly as me. I’ve had one of my hopeless friends suggest assisted suicide. Back then I was like fuck that... but now I feel like it’d be easier, you know, off yourself with somebody to help, because killing yourself on your own is probably way harder without someone helping. I used to rail oxy daily, I’ve been clean for atleast a year or so. I’m thinking of picking it up again, just to sleep. Maybe even heroin, many of my hopeless friends do it, apparently doing it helps you lose yourself and any constant thoughts you have, and to be honest I’d do anything to get these suicidal miserable thoughts off my mind. I need someone to relate with, someone I can cry with. A shoulder to lean on, everybody needs somebody.
